description: Annex I Theme Hydrography - Physical Waters - Drainage Basin - AGE is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géoportail. This dataset contains the drainage basins of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. The dataset is structured according to the INSPIRE Annex I Theme Hydrography. The data is derived from the "AGE" - datasets. Description copied from catalog.inspire.geoportail.lu. Coverage: Géoportail. The publisher named on the listing is Géoportail. Its keywords include drainagebasin, observation-de-la-terre-et-environnement, hvd, inspire, hydrography, national. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
